rewards.redemption_notes: Maximum Point value applies to Points redeemed for a deposit into an eligible U.S. Bank Account. Redemption value may differ for travel, merchandise, gift cards, and/or statement credit. Points will expire if there is no reward, purchase, or balance activity on your account for 12 consecutive statement cycles. Cardmembers may transfer points between Business Altitude Connect, Business Altitude Power, Altitude Go, and Altitude Connect cards.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 75,000 bonus points (up to a $750 value) after spending $10,000 on the Account Owner's card in the first 120 days of opening your account.

benefits.title: ExtendPay® Plan $0 Fee Offer
benefits.description: Receive a new cardmember $0 fee offer on ExtendPay Plans opened in the first 60 days after account opening. Not all accounts are eligible for ExtendPay Plans.

benefits.title: Transfer Points Between Cards
benefits.description: Redeem points sooner when you transfer points between your business and personal Altitude credit cards. Points do not expire as long as the account remains active.
